title: HomeFlood Renewal Term Premium — Rating Desk Calculation
content:
**Calculation.** The renewal term premium booked when a HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies policy renews is the premium on the renewal offer for the coming term, rounded to the cent, and never below the tier's minimum annual premium.

**The renewal offer.** This is the renewal offer entry for the coming term start, that is, the entry whose offered term begins on the expiring term's end date. Where several such entries share the latest recorded date, the one recorded first counts.

**Rounding.** The figure is rounded to the cent once, at the end. Rounding takes the nearest cent; an amount lying exactly halfway between two cents goes to the even cent.

| Offer premium compared with the tier minimum | Renewal term premium |
|---|---|
| at or above the minimum | the offer premium, rounded to the cent |
| below the minimum | the tier's minimum annual premium |

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

- A HomeFlood Plus renewal offer at 1,234.56 gives a renewal term premium of 1,234.56.
- A HomeFlood Renters renewal offer at 118.40 is below the Renters minimum of 125, so the renewal term premium is 125.00.
